-- External Datasource
-- External file format
-- location

CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT CsvFileFormat
WITH (
    FORMAT_TYPE = DELIMITEDTEXT,
    FORMAT_OPTIONS (
        FIELD_TERMINATOR = ',',
        STRING_DELIMITER = '"',
        FIRST_ROW = 2
    )
);

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE REVENUE_EXT_TABLE
(
    Region VARCHAR(2000),
    Country VARCHAR(2000),
    [Sales Reps] VARCHAR(2000),
    [First Name] VARCHAR(2000),
    [Last Name] VARCHAR(2000),
    Gender VARCHAR(2000),
    Age VARCHAR(2000),
    [Rank Levels] VARCHAR(2000),
    Rank VARCHAR(2000),
    Products VARCHAR(2000),
    Years INT,
    Quarter VARCHAR(2000),
    Month INT,
    [Revenue USD] VARCHAR(2000)
)
WITH (
    LOCATION = 'revenue',
    DATA_SOURCE = MyDataLake,
    FILE_FORMAT = CsvFileFormat
);

select * from REVENUE_EXT_TABLE;
